package.name: threevn_mlops
package.description:
Getting a model onto a robot, and getting it off again.
A model is not a file. It is a file, the data that produced it, the metrics that justify it, and a contract with the code that will run it. This package stores all four together, refuses to promote a model that fails any of them, and can put the previous one back in one command.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: never depends on Gazebo. What it serves runs on the robot.
